_note: UHN training-set Z-score parameters for EchoJEPA regression probes. Raw labels must be in native units — the inference pipeline applies (label - target_mean) / target_std at runtime and un-normalizes predictions back to native units for evaluation metrics. Same values are used across all four encoder models (echojepa-g, echojepa-l-k, echoprime, panecho) for a given task.
_usage: See zscore_params.md Sections 3-4. Add these to experiment.data in each regression YAML, or drop a task-specific zscore_params.json next to each CSV.

mv_ee_medial._description: MV e' (medial) — mitral annular tissue-Doppler velocity. Despite the task name, this is the velocity itself in cm/s, NOT the E/e' ratio. Expected value range ~3-25 cm/s.
